prompt: The Egypt wheat import figure in our comtrade_staples.json shows about $4.19B. A reviewer says that looks too high. Can you check whether it's right and tell me what to do?

assertions.text: Concludes the $4.19B figure is correct (verdict confirmed), not too high
Names UN Comtrade as primary source and FAOSTAT as independent cross-check
Explains the total_usd_m field holds raw USD (not millions) — the unit-label trap
Produces a structured verification record with provenance and as_of
